maria_cs: Hey team — customer asked for a short, customer-facing checklist and a 1-page FAQ we can hand to their ops team about caching/batching/streaming to reduce cost and avoid renewal risk. Can we put together a concise list?

jordan_se: I can draft the tech checklist. keep it actionable, <2 pages. include quick numbers: expected latency impact, cost delta. :+1:

lee_sre: Add a small runbook for degraded cases (fallback to smaller model, disable streaming fallback). Also include how to validate their prefills worked.

alex_support: I'll collect the top 6 customer questions we've gotten (from last 30 days) and paste answers. Common ones: "why are tokens spiking?", "how to warm pool?", "how to get consistent latency".

sam_pm: Suggest we include a single page 'What to watch for in first 72h' — signals: sustained P95 > 800ms, token spend +30% vs baseline, >5% 4xx errors. Those are renewal risk flags.

maria_cs: Perfect. For the draft, can we give simple config snippets customers can copy/paste (no internal-only flags)? Keep everything supported in hosted + dedicated.

jordan_se: Drafting now. Quick copy-paste samples below:

jordan_se: "Batching: set target_batch_latency_ms=20, max_batch_tokens=4096. For request-heavy short prompts (<64 tokens) target_batch_size=32."

jordan_se: "KV cache TTL: set kv_cache_ttl_seconds=300 for stable sessions; set to 30-60s for high churn flows."

jordan_se: "Streaming: enable_streaming=true + keepalive_ping_seconds=15 to avoid early stalls on mobile clients."

lee_sre: Add validation commands — customer can run a quick curl to verify prefix cache hit rate: 

lee_sre: ```
# curl to check cache hit metric (example)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.com/v1/metrics?metric=kv_cache_hit_rate
```

alex_support: FAQ bits — short answers: 
alex_support: "Q: Tokens spiking? A: Likely no client-side deduping of repeated prompts + low batching. Try batching + client-side dedupe and enable KV prefix caching."

alex_support: "Q: When to use streaming? A: Use streaming for long outputs when perceived latency matters; streaming adds small overheads, so combine with batching for short prompts."

sam_pm: For renewals: include a one-line escalation path — if customer sees sustained cost/latency degradation within first 7 days, open a dedicated cs-eng ticket and we'll prioritize a config review + temp credit.

maria_cs: Action items: Jordan draft checklist + snippets by EOD. Alex collect top-6 FAQs by noon. Lee draft 3 validation commands and a degraded-runbook. Sam prepare the '72h watchlist' copy. I'll stitch and publish to customer portal.

deploy_bot: deploy_bot: New doc draft pushed to /portal-drafts/cs/concierge-quickchecks-v1 (preview link: https://portal.redwood.internal/drafts/5689) :rocket:

jordan_se: Draft done — paste below (super concise):

jordan_se: "Customer Quickchecks — Caching/Batching/Streaming (1 page)
- Before go-live: prefill 10% of active tenants with KV cache for 24h, run baseline token profile.
- Batching: target 20–40ms batching latency, target_batch_size 16–32 for short prompts.
- KV cache: prefix-aware; TTL 300s for interactive, 30–60s for high churn.
- Streaming: enable when >512 tokens output expected; use keepalive 15s for mobile.
- Fallbacks: Canary a smaller quantized model and set automatic fallback when P95 > 1.5x SLO.
- Cost guard: set daily token budget + alert at 75% consumption.
- Signals to watch (72h): P95 latency, token/day delta, error rate (4xx/5xx).
- Escalation: open cs-eng ticket -> config review -> temp credit if platform issue."

alex_support: Nice. I'll paste the FAQs under the doc and add examples.

lee_sre: Degraded-runbook snippet: 
lee_sre: "If P95 > SLO for 30+ min: 1) Switch routing to dedicated region with spare capacity; 2) Reduce max_batch_tokens to lower tail latency; 3) Gradually enable smaller model fallback; 4) Notify customer and schedule config review."

sam_pm: Suggest adding a tiny table of 'expected perf improvement' bullets rather than numbers to avoid promising exact SLAs in a how-to. e.g., "batching -> lower per-token cost by ~20–50% for short prompts; KV cache -> latency down 30–60% on repeat queries".

maria_cs: Great. Can we finalize and make a PDF + 1-page HTML cheat sheet? I'm gonna share this in the customer kickoff pack.

jordan_se: I'll clean wording. Final draft ETA 5pm PT.

alex_support: Sending top-6 FAQs now.

alex_support: "1) Why did tokens spike after integration? -> Usually missing prompt dedupe + verbose system prompts. 2) How to avoid cold starts? -> Pre-warm 10% of users, use warm pools. 3) My streaming stalls on mobile -> enable keepalive pings and increase socket timeout. 4) Costs are unpredictable -> set token budget alerts and use batching. 5) High variance in latency -> check batch sizing and KV hit rates. 6) How to measure impact -> use per-route token and latency dashboards in Console."

maria_cs: Thanks — I'm good to go merge once Jordan's final wording is in. Assigning owner: maria_cs to publish. Due: tomorrow EOD.

sam_pm: I'll add the escalation template (one-liner) into the doc too.

lee_sre: quick note: include a small snippet for telemetry tags customers should send so we can correlate: service.customer_id, route.name, prompt_hash.

maria_cs: Done. Thanks everyone. Finalize and ping me when live. :white_check_mark:
